note: Baseline global defaults, d_min=0.05 over-declines in holdout period
d_min=0.03 — late-time production 2020-2025 averages ~185 bbl/mo with near-zero decline, terminal rate well below 5%. MAPE 0.267→0.1171
d_min=0.04 too steep for this wells flat late-time decline. MAPE 0.1171→0.1724. Reverted to d_min=0.03.
qi_guess_strategy=max3 produced identical results to first. The phase detection likely dominates qi initialization for this well.
b_initial=0.8 identical to 0.5. Optimizer converges to same solution regardless of initial b guess for this well.
outlier_window=5 catches sharp dips (2001-12: 1bbl, 2022-04: 8bbl). Rejection rate 1.2%→1.5%. MAPE 0.1171→0.1163.
outlier_window=7 marginally worse than 5 (0.1163→0.1164). Same rejection rate. Diminishing returns on wider window.
smoothing_window=5 reduces month-to-month noise. Fit months increased 327→336. MAPE 0.1163→0.1155.
significance_threshold=0.35 over-segments the well. In-sample R2 dropped 0.86→0.74, fit_months 336→307. Too many short phases. MAPE 0.1155→0.1187.
di_initial=0.3 identical to 0.5. Optimizer converges to same solution regardless of initial di guess.
